Appearance

            

              
Theme

              

                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
              

            

            

              
Window frame

              
              
Applies the next time the window is closed and reopened.

            

          


          

            
Product

            

              
              
Off = monitor only (no Discord / scheduler / Ollama startup). Restart after changing.

              
              
              
After an agent run, an optional LLM checks the result. Off by default. Failure-only (default when on) skips success on instant/lite lanes.

              
              
Sorts files in ~/Downloads on a schedule. Off by default. Dry-run stays on until you change config. Use /downloads for status.

              
              
Vault orient / prefetch / capture hooks. Off by default. Still needs ORI_VAULT (and optional hook env). Use /ori for status.

              
              
Discord casual channels + idle thoughts. On by default when unset. Channel list stays in discord_channels.json. Use /having_fun for status.

              
              
Transcribe Discord voice notes with local Ollama + ffmpeg. On by default when unset. Needs Ollama model and ffmpeg. Use /voice for status.

              
              
              
Smaller window; collapses Agent Ops / chat / monitors until you open them.

              

                
                
              

              

            

          


          

            
Credentials

            

              
Discord bot

              
Unknown

              
              

                
                
                
              

              
Saving connects right away. Restart to disconnect after clearing. Logs include Discord and app output.

            

            

              
Perplexity API key

              
Unknown

              
              

                
                
              

              
Get a key at perplexity.ai/settings/api. Stored in Keychain.

            

            

              
Brave Search API key

              
Unknown

              
              

                
                
              

              
Get a key at api-dashboard.search.brave.com. Stored in Keychain (or set BRAVE_API_KEY in .config.env).

            

            

              
Redmine

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
Base URL + API key for tickets and time entries. Stored in Keychain (or set REDMINE_URL / REDMINE_API_KEY in .config.env).

            

            

              
Mastodon

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
Instance URL + access token for MASTODON_POST. Stored in Keychain (or set MASTODON_INSTANCE_URL / MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN in .config.env).

            

            

              
MCP server

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
HTTP/SSE URL or stdio pipe string for MCP tools. Either is enough. Stored in Keychain (or set MCP_SERVER_URL / MCP_SERVER_STDIO in .config.env).

            

            

              
Browser / CDP

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
Chromium executable + CDP port for BROWSER_* tools. Saved in ~/.mac-stats/config.json (browserChromiumExecutable / browserCdpPort). Clear restores default Chrome + port 9222.

            

            

              
Cursor agent

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
Workspace + optional binary for CURSOR_AGENT. Saved in ~/.mac-stats/config.json (cursorAgentWorkspace / cursorAgentExecutable). Clear restores PATH default + ~/projects/mac-stats when present.

            

            

              
Telegram alerts

              
Unknown

              
              
              

                
                
              

              
Bot token + chat id for alert delivery. Stored in Keychain; channel registers on Save and restores at startup. /telegram shows Ready when both are set.

            

            

              
Slack alerts

              
Unknown

              
              

                
                
              

              
Incoming webhook URL for alert delivery. Stored in Keychain; channel registers on Save and restores at startup. /slack shows Ready when set.

            

            

              
Signal alerts

              
Not wired

              
Signal REST API / signal-cli is not wired yet. Alerts cannot send to Signal. Use Telegram or Slack for now. /signal shows this status.
